papers_summary: Papers cover AI in writing, financial advice evaluation, CPR training with visualization, data fact outlier exploration, public health visualization practices, mobile analytics for group discussions, social finance simulation, causal knowledge injection for virtual cells, scientific data compression, and speech-driven data visualization queries.
